about: Moods for the graded benchmark (scripts/graded_eval.py). 'hand' moods are the 15 in notebooks/1-evaluation.py; 'pooled' moods have no hand-written gold list and are scored from eval/judgments.json alone. 'null' queries have no right answer in a horror corpus.
hand: campy fun with lots of blood
slasher with suspense and a masked killer
pooled: creature feature with a monster in the water
horror comedy that is actually funny
ghost story that is sad more than scary
serial killer procedural, grim and realistic
black and white classic monster movie
trapped in one location with a killer
claustrophobic, underground or in a cave
something scary but not gory for a first-timer
grief and trauma as the monster
twisty mind-bending horror with a big reveal
gothic period piece in a crumbling mansion
small town with a dark secret
killer stalking a summer camp or the woods
social thriller about race or class
horror on a ship or underwater
